Purpose
The purpose of this Change Request (CR) is to introduce relationship remapping between the 1st Insured and 2nd Insured within the DCS
application. This enhancement aims to ensure accurate representation of insured relationships for policy processing, compliance, and
downstream system integrations used by BRAC.
Objectives
• Enable relationship types & remapping between the 1st Insured and 2nd Insured in the DCS app.
• Implement Transgender option in the relation mapping.
• The relationship between 1st & 2nd Insured when Transgender being involved will be like following
1st Insured / Borrower Gender 2nd Insured Gender 2nd Insured Relationship with Borrower / 1st Insured
Transgender Male Husband, Son, Father
Transgender Female Wife, Daughter, Mother
Male Transgender Son, Father, Wife, Daughter, Mother
Female Transgender Son, Father, Husband, Daughter, Mother
Transgender Transgender Husband, Son, Father, Wife, Daughter, Mother
Users
The users involved in the process will include:
• CO/PO, BM/AM from the DCS application

Scope Identification Description
This CR will provide the APIs of
Various information to enable the remapped relationship mapping between 1st & 2nd Insured
In Scope • Loan Proposal API
• Loan Proposal Update API
• Loan Pre Validation API
Out of Scope Any Insurance Except CSI is out of scope
